state: Gomrey candidate f5881ea, branch feature/rea/w2a-animation-wiring, base feature/rea/nextslide-gamma-wave1 at 6dde5b4a8faea32c64811ee818f053d5fc12dbe3. W2a depends on wave 1, which introduced the slide animation contract at servers/nextjs/lib/slide-animations/ (catalog, stylesheet, index). WHAT THE CHANGE DOES: adds an ElementAnimation model (name, optional delay_ms, optional duration) to servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py and declares an animation field on the animatable element types (text, text-list, table, vector, chart, infographic, image). Structural containers (container, flex, grid, group) are deliberately excluded. It adds a strip of the animation field from the layout-generation JSON schema, plus a prune of the $defs entry that removal orphans, in servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/layouts.py. It adds the animation class emission and the conditional inlining of the animation stylesheet to servers/nextjs/lib/template-v2-json-to-html.ts. It adds 20 tests: 10 in servers/fastapi/tests/test_slide_animation_model.py and 10 in servers/nextjs/tests/slide-animations-rendering.test.mjs. WHICH AGENT TOOLS IT ADDS OR MODIFIES: none. No MCP tool, tool schema, tool registry, tool result shape or tool invocation path is added, removed or modified. The MCP server is untouched. No language-model call is added or modified. WHY THE FIELD IS DECLARED ON THE ELEMENT MODEL: the template's elements are parsed as SlideElement and pydantic's default is to ignore extra fields, so had the animation been added only to the renderer it would have been dropped at parse time with no error. There is a regression test for that. THE ANIMATION IS A TEMPLATE-AUTHORING DECISION: the content schema is built from a per-type whitelist in templates/v2/schema.py so it cannot leak; the layout-generation schema strips it explicitly; and the template application deep-copies the template element and replaces only the content fields, so a model-supplied animation could never win. GATES ON THIS EXACT REVISION: FastAPI pytest 1135 passed (1125 baseline + 10 new); root npm test 48/48; Next.js node --test 111/111 (101 wave-1 baseline + 10 new); scan-secrets, check-fixtures, check-platform-support, validate-release-config, release-manifest and validate-contracts all OK.
